comp.summary: Composition-level operations: create comp, add guides, settings

scene.summary: Multi-layer scene building blocks: backdrops, title stacks, camera rigs

layer.summary: Individual layer creation and manipulation: footage import, shape layers

effect.summary: Visual effects applied as adjustment layers: grain, flicker, glow, gate weave, etc.

preset.summary: Compound actions composing multiple blocks into curated looks or scenes

utility.summary: Data processing, timing calculations, and non-AE helpers

actions.name: Add 3D Break
actions.description: Adds an adjustment layer above the highest selected layer, or near the top when nothing is selected, to break 3D interaction.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { name: string (default "=== 3D Break ==="), color: [r,g,b] (default [0.5,0.5,0.5]) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to insert a 3D-break adjustment layer in the stack without building it manually.

actions.name: Add Additional Animation Control
actions.description: Adds a Slider or Angle Control to the owning layer for each selected 1D property, then links the property so the controller adds an offset to the original value.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), controlPrefix: string (default "Additional "), forceType: "slider"|"angle" (optional) }
actions.outputs: number — count of controls created and linked
actions.whenToUse: You want an extra animator-friendly offset control next to an existing property without rewriting the full expression rig by hand.

actions.name: Add Backdrop
actions.description: Creates a three-layer atmospheric backdrop: dark base solid, warm accent band, bright signal line.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { } (no opts for v1 — defaults are opinionated)
actions.whenToUse: You want a quick tone-setting backdrop for a demo or presentation comp.

actions.name: Add Beat Markers
actions.description: Places evenly-spaced comp markers from t=0 through comp.duration, labeled "Beat 1", "Beat 2", etc.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { spacingSeconds: number (default 1.0, minimum 0.25) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a regular beat grid on the timeline for timing reference or music sync.

actions.name: Add Camera
actions.description: Creates a camera layer with configurable zoom and depth of field settings.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { name: string (default "Camera"), zoom: number (optional, pixels — AE default if omitted), depthOfField: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: CameraLayer — the newly created camera layer
actions.whenToUse: You need a standalone camera layer without a full orbit rig. Use addCameraRig for an animated orbit rig.
actions.example: var cam = addCamera(comp, { name: "Main Camera", depthOfField: true });

actions.name: Add Camera Rig
actions.description: Adds an orbit camera rig: a 3D camera parented to a null controller with a gentle Y-rotation animation.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { } (no opts for v1)
actions.whenToUse: You want a 3D camera that slowly orbits the scene over the comp's duration.

actions.name: Add Color Grade
actions.description: Adds a color grade adjustment layer: Glow + Vignette + Levels stack for a warm, contrast-crushed analog look.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { glowIntensity: number (default 0.2, Glow intensity 0-1), vignetteAmount: number (default 50, CS Vignette amount 0-100) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a subtle warm glow, vignette, and crushed levels for an analog or cinematic color treatment.

actions.name: Add Expression Control
actions.description: Adds an expression control effect to a layer (Slider, Angle, Checkbox, Color, Point, 3D Point, or Dropdown). Maps type strings to correct ADBE match names and sets the initial value on the correct sub-property.
actions.inputs: layer: AVLayer; opts: { type: "slider"|"angle"|"checkbox"|"color"|"point"|"point3d"|"dropdown" (required), name: string (optional display name), value:
actions.outputs: PropertyGroup — the newly applied expression control effect
actions.whenToUse: You need a slider, color picker, checkbox, or other control on a null or adjustment layer for expression linking.
actions.example: var ctrl = addExpressionControl(nullLayer, { type: "slider", name: "Speed", value: 50 });

actions.name: Add Expression Rig
actions.description: Creates a null controller layer loaded with expression control effects (sliders, colors, checkboxes, etc.) for driving expressions across a comp. Returns the null layer and an array of the applied control effects.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { controls: Array<{ name: string, type: "slider"|"angle"|"checkbox"|"color"|"point"|"point3d"|"dropdown", value:
actions.whenToUse: You need a single controller null with multiple expression controls so expressions throughout the comp can reference one authoritative source.
actions.example: var rig = addExpressionRig(comp, { controls: [{ name: "Speed", type: "slider", value: 50 }, { name: "Primary Color", type: "color", value: [1, 0.5, 0] }] });

actions.name: Add Film Damage Treatment
actions.description: Composes gate_weave + grain + flicker + color_grade into a four-layer film damage look.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { } (no opts for v1 — pass opts to individual blocks for fine control)
actions.outputs: Object — { gateWeave, grain, flicker, colorGrade } (the four adjustment layers)
actions.whenToUse: You want an instant analog/film-damage look applied on top of existing comp layers without choosing individual effects.

actions.name: Add Flicker
actions.description: Adds a flicker adjustment layer: an Exposure effect with a wiggle expression to simulate random brightness fluctuation.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { speed: number (default 12, wiggle frequency in Hz), amount: number (default 0.1, wiggle amplitude in stops) }
actions.whenToUse: You want random brightness flicker simulating aging film or unstable lighting.

actions.name: Add Gate Weave
actions.description: Adds a gate-weave adjustment layer: a Transform effect with wiggle expressions on position and scale to simulate film gate instability.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { intensity: number (default 1.0, scale multiplier for wiggle amounts) }
actions.whenToUse: You want subtle horizontal/vertical camera shake simulating a film gate slipping in the projector gate.

actions.name: Add Glitch Intro
actions.description: Builds a complete glitch-style motion graphics intro: fractal noise driver comp,
actions.inputs: opts: {
actions.outputs: Object — { fractalComp, artworkSeqComp, artworkLoopComp, mainIntroComp, finalComp }
actions.whenToUse: You want a full glitch-style intro from scratch: triangle reveal, artwork flicker,
actions.example: var result = addGlitchIntro({ artworkItems: myImages, logoComp: logo, katakanaComp: kata });

actions.name: Add Grain
actions.description: Adds a grain adjustment layer: Noise + Gaussian Blur + Unsharp Mask stack to simulate analog film grain.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { amount: number (default 10, Noise amount 0-100), blurRadius: number (default 6, Gaussian Blur blurriness) }
actions.whenToUse: You want organic film-style grain on a comp without a full film damage treatment.

actions.name: Add Guide Preset
actions.description: Adds a named group of compositional guides to a comp (thirds, safe margins, or center cross).
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { preset: "thirds"|"safe"|"center" }
actions.outputs: number — count of guides added (0 if preset name is unrecognized)
actions.whenToUse: You need standard guide layouts in a comp. Requires AE 16.1+ (comp.addGuide).

actions.name: Add Labeled Items To Render Queue
actions.description: Queues every composition in the project whose label color matches the requested label.
actions.inputs: opts: { label: string|number (default "green") }
actions.outputs: number — count of comps added to the render queue
actions.whenToUse: You organize comps by label color and want to batch-queue only the marked items for rendering.

actions.name: Add Layer From Item
actions.description: Adds a FootageItem or CompItem to a comp as a new AVLayer with
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: {
actions.whenToUse: You need to place a footage item or comp inside another comp and control
actions.example: var layer = addLayerFromItem(mainComp, { item: logoComp, inPoint: 2, duration: 4 });

actions.name: Add Light
actions.description: Creates a light layer of the specified type (point, spot, parallel, ambient) with configurable intensity, color, and shadow options.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { type: "point"|"spot"|"parallel"|"ambient" (default "point"), name: string (default "Light"), position: [x,y,z] (default comp center, z=-600), intensity: number (default 100), color: [r,g,b] (default [1,1,1]), coneAngle: number (spot only, default 90), castsShadows: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: LightLayer — the newly created light layer
actions.whenToUse: You need a 3D scene light. Maps type strings to LightType enum; only sets cone angle for spot lights.
actions.example: var light = addLight(comp, { type: "spot", intensity: 120, coneAngle: 60, castsShadows: true });

actions.name: Add Markers At Out Points
actions.description: Places composition markers at the out points of layers. Defaults to all layers in the comp and supports an optional shared marker comment.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default all comp layers), comment: string (default "") }
actions.outputs: number — count of markers written to the comp marker stream
actions.whenToUse: You want timeline markers at each layer end for timing review, edit points, or export prep.

actions.name: Add Markers At Selected Keyframes
actions.description: Adds a layer marker at the time of each selected keyframe on the selected properties. Each selected keyframe becomes a marker on its owning layer.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), comment: string (default "") }
actions.outputs: number — count of markers added to layers
actions.whenToUse: You want layer markers aligned to specific selected animation beats without placing them by hand.

actions.name: Add Markers At Work Area
actions.description: Adds composition markers at the start and end of the work area with configurable comments.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { startComment: string (default "start"), endComment: string (default "end") }
actions.whenToUse: You want marker anchors for the current work area before trimming, exporting, or syncing other tools to a segment.

actions.name: Add Markers To Selected Layers
actions.description: Places a layer marker on each selected layer at a shared time, with an optional shared comment.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), time: number (default comp.time), comment: string (default "") }
actions.outputs: number — count of layer markers added
actions.whenToUse: You want to stamp the same marker onto multiple selected layers at the current time or a specified time.

actions.name: Add Mask
actions.description: Adds a mask to a layer with rectangle, ellipse, or custom bezier shape. Uses verified ADBE match names (ADBE Mask Parade, ADBE Mask Atom, ADBE Mask Shape, ADBE Mask Feather, ADBE Mask Opacity, ADBE Mask Offset).
actions.inputs: layer: AVLayer; opts: { shape: "rectangle"|"ellipse"|"custom" (default "rectangle"), rect: [x,y,w,h] (rectangle/ellipse, default full comp bounds), vertices: [x,y][] (custom only), inTangents: [x,y][] (custom), outTangents: [x,y][] (custom), mode: "add"|"subtract"|"intersect"|"lighten"|"darken"|"difference"|"none" (default "add"), feather: [fx,fy] (default [0,0]), opacity: number (0–100, default 100), expansion: number (default 0), inverted: boolean (default false), name: string (optional display name) }
actions.outputs: MaskPropertyGroup — the newly created mask group
actions.whenToUse: You need to add a rectangular, elliptical, or custom bezier mask to any layer. Coordinates are in comp space.
actions.example: var mask = addMask(layer, { shape: "rectangle", rect: [100, 100, 800, 400], feather: [20, 20] });

actions.name: Add Null
actions.description: Creates a null object layer for use as a controller, parent anchor, or expression target.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { name: string (default "Null Controller"), position: [x,y] (default comp center), is3D: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: AVLayer — the newly created null layer
actions.whenToUse: You need an invisible controller layer for parenting, expressions, or camera rigs.
actions.example: var ctrl = addNull(comp, { name: "Camera CTRL", is3D: true });

actions.name: Add Posterize Time Adjustment Layer
actions.description: Creates an adjustment solid with the Posterize Time effect applied.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { fps: number (default half of comp frame rate rounded up), name: string (default "Posterize Time"), color: [r,g,b] (default [0.5,0.5,0.5]) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to posterize the whole comp with a single adjustment layer rather than per-property expressions.

actions.name: Add Posterize Time Expression
actions.description: Prepends `posterizeTime(fps); value;` to selected expression-capable properties while preserving any existing expression code.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), fps: number (default half of comp frame rate rounded up) }
actions.whenToUse: You want stepped motion on selected properties without deleting the expressions they already have.

actions.name: Add Selected Compositions To Render Queue
actions.description: Adds selected project-panel comps to the render queue and optionally applies output templates based on comp naming rules.
actions.inputs: opts: { defaultTemplate: string (default "H.264 MP4"), alphaTemplate: string (default "Apple ProRes 4444 + Alpha"), alphaNameToken: string (default "_TEXT_") }
actions.whenToUse: You want to queue selected comps from the project panel with predictable output module templates.

actions.name: Add Selection To New Folder
actions.description: Creates a new project-panel folder and moves selected project items into it.
actions.inputs: opts: { name: string (required) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to quickly group selected project items under a new folder.

actions.name: Add Shape Layer
actions.description: Creates a shape layer with rectangle, ellipse, polygon, or star geometry, plus optional fill and stroke. Uses correct ADBE match-name nesting to avoid property-path pitfalls.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { name: string, position: [x,y] (default comp center), shape: "rectangle"|"ellipse"|"polygon"|"star" (default "rectangle"), size: [w,h] (default [200,200]), points: number (polygon/star), innerRadius: number (star), outerRadius: number (star/polygon), fillColor: [r,g,b] (null = no fill), strokeColor: [r,g,b] (null = no stroke), strokeWidth: number (default 2), roundness: number (rectangle only) }
actions.outputs: ShapeLayer — the newly created shape layer
actions.whenToUse: You need a shape layer with a specific geometry. Handles correct ADBE nesting and sets star type before inner radius to prevent AE errors.
actions.example: var layer = addShapeLayer(comp, { shape: "rectangle", size: [400, 200], fillColor: [0.2, 0.4, 1] });

actions.name: Add Simple Loop Expression
actions.description: Applies a loop expression to each selected animatable property. Direction, loop type, and optional keyframe count are parameterized instead of using a dialog.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), direction: "loopIn"|"loopOut" (default "loopOut"), type: "cycle"|"pingpong"|"offset"|"continue" (default "cycle"), keyframes: number (default 0) }
actions.outputs: number — count of properties that received the loop expression
actions.whenToUse: You want to add a standard AE loop expression to multiple selected properties without opening a prompt.
actions.example: var count = addSimpleLoopExpression(comp, { direction: "loopOut", type: "pingpong", keyframes: 2 });

actions.name: Add Solid
actions.description: Creates a solid color layer with configurable color, dimensions, duration, and adjustment layer mode.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { color: [r,g,b] (default [1,1,1]), name: string (default "Solid"), width: number (default comp.width), height: number (default comp.height), duration: number (default comp.duration), isAdjustment: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: AVLayer — the newly created solid layer
actions.whenToUse: You need a solid color layer for backgrounds, mattes, color fills, or adjustment layer bases.
actions.example: var layer = addSolid(comp, { color: [0.07, 0.09, 0.14], name: "BG Dark", isAdjustment: false });

actions.name: Add Star Trim Animation
actions.description: Adds an animated 5-point star shape layer with a trim-paths draw-on animation over 1 second.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { points: number, innerRadius: number, outerRadius: number } (all optional)
actions.outputs: ShapeLayer — the newly created star layer
actions.whenToUse: You want a shape-layer star with a trim-paths reveal animation as a motion design element.

actions.name: Add Text Animator
actions.description: Adds a text animator preset to a text layer: typeOn (opacity reveal), fadeUp (opacity + position), trackingIn (tracking collapse), or scaleBounce (scale reveal with overshoot). Uses Range Selectors and keyframes for time-based animation.
actions.inputs: layer: TextLayer; opts: { preset: "typeOn"|"fadeUp"|"trackingIn"|"scaleBounce" (default "typeOn"), duration: number (seconds, default 1.0), stagger: number (0-1 smoothness, default 0.05) }
actions.outputs: PropertyGroup — the newly added text animator
actions.whenToUse: You need a quick entrance animation on a text layer without manually building animators and range selectors.

actions.name: Add Text Layer
actions.description: Creates a text layer with full styling control. Applies all required AE TextDocument rules: applyFill before fillColor, explicit justification, anchor reset to [0,0], full property path access.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { text: string (default ""), fontSize: number (default 48), fillColor: [r,g,b] (default [1,1,1]), font: string, justification: "left"|"center"|"right" (default "center"), position: [x,y] (default comp center), name: string, tracking: number, leading: number }
actions.outputs: TextLayer — the newly created text layer
actions.whenToUse: You need a text layer with reliable styling. Prevents common pitfalls: applyFill, justification, anchor drift, and property path issues.
actions.example: var layer = addTextLayer(comp, { text: "Hello World", fontSize: 72, fillColor: [1, 1, 0], justification: "center" });

actions.name: Add Title Stack
actions.description: Adds a two-layer animated title stack (hero title + subtitle) with fade and slide-up keyframes.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { title: string, subtitle: string } (both optional — defaults to demo copy)
actions.whenToUse: You want a quick hero text layout with entrance animation for demo or presentation comps.
actions.example: var layers = addTitleStack(comp, { title: "My Project", subtitle: "A short description" });

actions.name: Add Visibility Controller
actions.description: Creates a null controller with a Checkbox Control, then links selected layer opacity to that checkbox so one toggle can show or hide the group.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), controllerName: string (default "Visibility Controller"), controlName: string (default "Visible"), initialValue: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want one shared visibility toggle for one or more layers instead of adding separate checkbox controls to each layer.

actions.name: Append To Expression
actions.description: Prepends custom expression code to selected properties that already have enabled expressions.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), code: string (required) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to batch-insert shared expression code such as `posterizeTime()` or utility variables across selected properties.

actions.name: Apply Effect
actions.description: Applies an effect to a layer by ADBE match name, then sets any specified property values. Validates the layer type and provides a clear error if the effect match name is not found (e.g. missing third-party plugin).
actions.inputs: layer: AVLayer; opts: { matchName: string (required, ADBE match name), properties: Object (matchName or display name -> value pairs, optional), name: string (optional display name override) }
actions.outputs: PropertyGroup — the newly applied effect group
actions.whenToUse: You need to apply any built-in or third-party effect to a layer by match name. Use this instead of hard-coding effect application logic. Warn the user if their project may not have required third-party plugins.
actions.example: var blur = applyEffect(layer, { matchName: "ADBE Gaussian Blur 2", properties: { "ADBE Gaussian Blur 2-0001": 20 } });

actions.name: Apply Maintain Stroke Width Expression
actions.description: Finds every vector stroke width property in the comp and applies an expression that visually preserves stroke width despite scaling.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default all comp layers), expression: string (default maintain-stroke-width expression) }
actions.outputs: number ‚Äî count of stroke width properties updated
actions.whenToUse: You want scalable shape layers to keep a consistent apparent stroke weight.

actions.name: Build Demo Scene
actions.description: Creates a fully composed demo scene: new comp + backdrop + guides (thirds + safe) + title stack + camera rig + beat markers.
actions.inputs: opts: { name: string, width: number, height: number, duration: number, fps: number, spacingSeconds: number }
actions.whenToUse: You want to build a complete demo comp with all standard building blocks in one call.
actions.example: var comp = buildDemoScene({ name: "Demo", width: 1920, height: 1080, duration: 8, fps: 24, spacingSeconds: 1 });

actions.name: Build Dropdown Selector
actions.description: Creates a guide controller layer with a Dropdown Control that toggles target layer opacity. The dropdown can also be added to Essential Graphics.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { name: string (default "Controller"), targetLayers: AVLayer[] (default all layers except controller), addToEssentialGraphics: boolean (default true), hideNonSelectedAsZero: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: Object — { controller: ShapeLayer, dropdown: Property, count: number }
actions.whenToUse: You want a single dropdown to switch between multiple layer visibility states in a comp or Essential Graphics template.

actions.name: Build Motion Graphic Scene
actions.description: Creates a complete motion graphic comp: background solid, title + subtitle text layers, accent shapes, and guide preset. Three style tokens control the palette and geometry.
actions.inputs: opts: { name: string (default "MG Scene"), width: number (default 1920), height: number (default 1080), duration: number (default 8), fps: number (default 24), title: string (default "Title"), subtitle: string (default "Subtitle"), bgColor: [r,g,b] (overrides style default), style: "minimal"|"bold"|"tech" (default "minimal") }
actions.outputs: Object — { comp, bg, title, subtitle, accent } (layers may be null if creation fails)
actions.whenToUse: You need a production-ready motion graphic starting point without assembling every layer individually. Pick a style token and supply copy.
actions.example: var scene = buildMotionGraphicScene({ title: "Q4 Review", subtitle: "Sales & Marketing", style: "bold" });

actions.name: Calculate Distance Between Layers
actions.description: Calculates the distance between two layers in either composition or world space.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layerA: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]), layerB: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[1]), space: "world"|"composition" (default inferred: world unless both 2D), keepTempEffects: boolean (default false) }
actions.whenToUse: You need a numeric distance measurement between two layers for layout or rigging.

actions.name: Center Composition
actions.description: Sets the active viewer zoom to a normalized composition-centered zoom level.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { zoom: number (default 0.5) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a predictable centered comp view from scripting instead of relying on modifier keys.

actions.name: Clean Render Queue
actions.description: Removes every item from the render queue.
actions.inputs: opts: { } (no options)
actions.outputs: number — count of render queue items removed
actions.whenToUse: You want to clear the render queue before building a new batch.

actions.name: Connect Two Layers With A Line
actions.description: Creates a shape layer with an expression-driven path connecting two layers by their anchor points.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layerA: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]), layerB: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[1]), strokeColor: [r,g,b] (default [1,1,1]), strokeWidth: number (default 3), name: string (default "Connection Line") }
actions.whenToUse: You want a live connection line between two moving layers for diagrams, graphs, or network visuals.

actions.name: Copy Composition Markers To Layer
actions.description: Copies all comp markers to a target layer, preserving comment, duration, and label.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layer: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]) }
actions.outputs: number — count of markers copied to the layer
actions.whenToUse: You want a layer-local copy of composition markers for downstream animation or export logic.

actions.name: Copy Layer Markers To Composition
actions.description: Copies all markers from a source layer to the composition marker stream, preserving comment, duration, and label.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layer: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]) }
actions.outputs: number — count of markers copied to the composition
actions.whenToUse: You want layer-authored markers promoted to the comp timeline for broader timing use.

actions.name: Create Comp
actions.description: Creates a new composition in the project with a dark background and opens it in the viewer.
actions.inputs: opts: { name: string, width: number, height: number, duration: number, fps: number }
actions.whenToUse: You need to create a new comp programmatically with specific dimensions. Does NOT require an existing comp.
actions.example: var comp = createCompFromValues({ name: "My Comp", width: 1920, height: 1080, duration: 8, fps: 24 });

actions.name: Data Timing
actions.description: Calculates and recalculates display durations for data-driven text elements using a words-per-second model. Exposes three primary functions: computeDurationFromText, resolveElementDuration, recalculateDurationsOnJson.
actions.inputs: data: Object (with elements/messages array); targetSecondsPerWord: number; targetMinDuration: number
actions.outputs: boolean — true if any durations were changed
actions.whenToUse: Display duration should vary based on text length (subtitle timing, auto-paced slideshows, narration sync).

runnerMeta.note: Operates on JSON data objects — call recalculateDurationsOnJson() in a script.

actions.name: Disable Selected Expressions
actions.description: Disables expressions on selected expression-capable properties.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to temporarily silence selected expressions without deleting the expression text.

actions.name: Enable Collapse Transformations
actions.description: Enables collapse transformations on eligible layers. By default it operates on the active comp, and can optionally scan all comps in the project.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { allComps: boolean (default false), protectMarkerComment: string (default "Do Not Collapse Transformations"), unlockLayers: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to batch-enable collapse transformations while respecting marker-based exclusions.

actions.name: Enable Motion Blur
actions.description: Enables or disables motion blur on the active comp by default, or all comps and their layers when `allComps` is true.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { enabled: boolean (default true), allComps: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a consistent project-wide motion blur state without opening comp settings one by one.
actions.example: var count = enableMotionBlur(comp, { enabled: true, allComps: true });

actions.name: Enable Selected Expressions
actions.description: Enables expressions on selected properties that already contain expression code.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to re-enable selected expressions that were previously disabled.

actions.name: Ensure Project Folder
actions.description: Finds or creates a folder in the AE Project panel. Supports nested paths using "/" as a separator (e.g. "Assets/Images" creates "Assets" at the root, then "Images" inside it). A parentFolder can be passed to resolve the path relative to an existing folder.
actions.inputs: opts: { name: string (required, may contain "/" for nested paths), parentFolder: FolderItem (default: project root) }
actions.outputs: FolderItem — the deepest folder in the path (created if it did not exist)
actions.whenToUse: You need to organize imported footage, comps, or other items into project panel folders. Safely re-uses existing folders; never creates duplicates.

actions.name: Fill In Keyframes
actions.description: Bakes selected animated properties into per-frame keyframes, then removes redundant in-betweens and normalizes interpolation to linear.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You need explicit in-between keyframes for an animation, such as after baking motion or preparing data for export.

actions.name: Find All Expressions
actions.description: Scans the whole project and returns every active expression with its comp and layer context.
actions.inputs: opts: { } (no options)
actions.whenToUse: You want an inventory of active expressions before export, cleanup, or Lottie prep.

actions.name: Find Specific Effect
actions.description: Scans every comp and returns all layer/effect matches for one or more effect match names.
actions.inputs: opts: { effectMatchNames: string[]|string (default "ADBE Gaussian Blur 2") }
actions.outputs: Array<Object> — [{ compName, layerName, layerIndex, effectName, matchName }]
actions.whenToUse: You want an inventory of where a specific effect is used across the project.
actions.example: var matches = findSpecificEffect({ effectMatchNames: ["ADBE Gaussian Blur 2"] });

actions.name: Flip Path
actions.description: Flips selected shape or mask paths horizontally or vertically around each path's bounding-box center. Supports both static and keyframed paths.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), direction: "horizontal"|"vertical" (default "horizontal") }
actions.outputs: number — count of path properties updated
actions.whenToUse: You need to mirror selected mask or vector paths without manually editing vertices.

actions.name: Hard Solo Layers
actions.description: Disables every unselected layer in the comp and leaves selected layers enabled.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { invert: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: number — count of layers left enabled
actions.whenToUse: You want a destructive-style solo state that relies on the `enabled` switch instead of the temporary solo flag.

actions.name: Image Swap
actions.description: Imports footage files, replaces layer sources, and scales layers to fit or fill a comp. Exposes five functions: replaceLayerSource, fitLayerToComp, getOrImportFootage, importFolderAssets, ensureProjectFolder.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layerNameOrIndex: string|number, footageFile: File, fitMode: "fit"|"fill" }
actions.outputs: boolean — true if the source was successfully replaced
actions.whenToUse: You need to import external images and swap layer sources with proper fit/fill scaling.
actions.example: replaceLayerSource(comp, { layerNameOrIndex: "Photo", footageFile: new File("/path/img.jpg"), fitMode: "fill" });

runnerMeta.note: Requires a File path — call replaceLayerSource() in a script.

actions.name: Increment Composition Versions
actions.description: Increments `_vNN` style version suffixes on compositions in the project.
actions.inputs: opts: { onlySelected: boolean (default false) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to batch-bump comp version numbers before delivery or iteration.

actions.name: Invert Selected Keyframes
actions.description: Multiplies each selected keyframe value by -1 on the selected properties. Supports both scalar and array values.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You need to mirror selected keyframe values across zero without manually editing each key.

actions.name: Keyframe Current Value From Expression
actions.description: Snapshots the current post-expression value of selected properties by writing a keyframe at the current time.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), time: number (default comp.time) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to bake the current result of an expression without converting the whole expression to keys.

actions.name: Keyframe Group Opacities
actions.description: Adds a keyframe at the current time to every shape-group opacity property found in the selected layers.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), time: number (default comp.time) }
actions.outputs: number — count of group opacity properties keyframed
actions.whenToUse: You want to snapshot all shape group opacities at once, especially after converting text animators to shapes.

actions.name: Lock All Layers
actions.description: Locks all layers in the active comp by default, or in every comp in the project when `allComps` is true.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { allComps: boolean (default false) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to freeze a comp or whole project against accidental layer edits.

actions.name: Make Hold Keyframes
actions.description: Converts selected keyframes on the selected properties into hold keyframes.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.outputs: number — count of keyframes converted to hold interpolation
actions.whenToUse: You want animation to step between values instead of interpolating smoothly.

actions.name: Multiply Selected Keyframes
actions.description: Multiplies selected keyframe values by a scalar multiplier on the selected properties.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), multiplier: number (default 2) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to proportionally scale selected animation values without editing each keyframe manually.

actions.name: Parent Opacity
actions.description: Applies an opacity expression so each selected child layer respects both its own opacity and its parent's opacity, using the lower of the two values.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), expression: string (default min(child,parent) opacity expression) }
actions.whenToUse: You want child layers to fade with their parent while preserving their own local opacity animation.

actions.name: Parent Selected Layers To Layers Below
actions.description: Parents each selected layer to the layer directly below it in stacking order. Layers at the bottom of the comp are skipped.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to quickly create a stack-based parent chain using the current layer order.

actions.name: Pre Compose
actions.description: Pre-composes a set of layers within a comp by 1-based index. Sorts indices ascending (required by AE), validates range, and returns the new CompItem.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layerIndices: number[] (required, 1-based), name: string (default "Pre-comp"), moveAttributes: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You need to collapse layers into a nested comp programmatically. Always pass indices as 1-based integers.
actions.example: var precomp = preCompose(comp, { layerIndices: [1, 2, 3], name: "BG Elements" });

actions.name: Prepare Layer Out Points For Lottie
actions.description: Extends any layer that ends exactly on the final frame by one frame, which avoids a common Lottie export edge case.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { allComps: boolean (default false) }
actions.outputs: number — count of layer out points adjusted
actions.whenToUse: You are preparing comps for Lottie export and want to avoid layers disappearing on the last frame.

actions.name: Queue Comp
actions.description: Adds a comp to the After Effects render queue.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem
actions.whenToUse: You want to programmatically send a comp to the render queue without touching the UI.

actions.name: Randomize Layer Start Time
actions.description: Randomly offsets selected layer start times within a frame range. Offsets are rounded to whole frames for deterministic timeline placement.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), rangeFrames: number (default 30), signed: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want organic staggered timing across duplicated or repeated layers without hand-offsetting each one.

actions.name: Remove Redundant Keyframes
actions.description: Removes consecutive keyframes whose values are effectively identical. Useful after baking expressions or oversampling animation.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties), tolerance: number (default 0.0001) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to reduce timeline noise by deleting keyframes that do not change the animation result.

actions.name: Rename Selected Layers With Numbers
actions.description: Renames selected layers using a base name plus zero-padded sequence numbers.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), baseName: string (default first selected layer name), startAt: number (default 1) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a consistent numbered naming scheme across a selected layer set.

actions.name: Reset Composition Work Area
actions.description: Resets the comp work area to span the full composition duration.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem
actions.outputs: boolean — true when the work area was reset
actions.whenToUse: You want to clear any trimmed work area and restore full-comp playback.

actions.name: Reset Layer Names
actions.description: Resets every layer name in the comp back to AE's default-derived name by assigning an empty string.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem
actions.outputs: number — count of layer names reset
actions.whenToUse: You want to clear custom naming in a comp and fall back to source/default layer names.

actions.name: Round Selected Keyframe Values
actions.description: Rounds the selected keyframe values of compatible 1D, 2D, and 3D properties to the nearest whole number.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You want cleaner numeric values after dragging, baking, or importing animation data.

actions.name: Round Selected Property Values
actions.description: Rounds the current values of selected non-animated 1D, 2D, and 3D properties to the nearest whole number.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You want cleaner static values after dragging, importing, or procedurally setting properties.

actions.name: Select All Children
actions.description: Selects all unlocked child layers of a single selected parent layer.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { parentLayer: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]), deselectParent: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: number — count of child layers selected
actions.whenToUse: You want to isolate every direct child of a selected parent layer.

actions.name: Select Disabled Layers
actions.description: Selects all unlocked disabled layers in the comp.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to quickly find hidden layers that are disabled via the eyeball switch.

actions.name: Select Guide Layers
actions.description: Selects all guide layers in the comp.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: number — count of guide layers selected
actions.whenToUse: You want to isolate guide layers for cleanup or editing.

actions.name: Select Non-Null Layers
actions.description: Selects all unlocked non-null layers in the comp.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to exclude null controllers from a bulk layer operation.

actions.name: Select Parent Layer
actions.description: Selects the parent of the first selected layer.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layer: AVLayer (default comp.selectedLayers[0]), deselectChild: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to jump from a child layer to its direct parent in one command.

actions.name: Select Random Layers
actions.description: Randomly selects unlocked layers in the comp using a threshold probability.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { threshold: number (default 0.5), clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a quick random subset of layers for experimentation or staggered operations.

actions.name: Select Shape Layers
actions.description: Selects all shape layers in the comp, unlocking them first if requested.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { unlockLayers: boolean (default true), clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: number — count of shape layers selected
actions.whenToUse: You want to isolate shape layers for styling or animation changes.

actions.name: Select Text Layers
actions.description: Selects all text layers in the comp. Optionally unlocks layers first so locked text layers can be selected as well.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { unlockLayers: boolean (default true), clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: number — count of text layers selected
actions.whenToUse: You want to isolate all text layers in a comp for batch styling, parenting, or cleanup.

actions.name: Select Unparented Layers
actions.description: Selects all unlocked layers in the comp that do not have a parent.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { clearSelection: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to find loose layers that are not attached to any rig or hierarchy.

actions.name: Set Expression
actions.description: Applies an expression string to an animatable property with three-guard validation: PROPERTY type check, canSetExpression check, and expression string check.
actions.inputs: prop: Property; opts: { expression: string (required) }
actions.outputs: boolean — true if the expression was applied successfully
actions.whenToUse: You need to apply an expression to a property. Guards against non-property groups and properties that don't support expressions.

runnerMeta.note: Operates on a specific Property — call setExpression(prop, { expression: '...' }) in a script.

actions.name: Set Keyframes
actions.description: Sets one or more keyframes on an animatable property, with configurable easing. Validates canVaryOverTime, sorts keyframes by time, and maps easing strings to KeyframeInterpolationType + KeyframeEase.
actions.inputs: prop: Property; opts: { keyframes: Array<{time: number, value:
actions.whenToUse: You need to set keyframe values on any animatable property with consistent easing. Handles both temporal and spatial properties.
actions.example: var count = setKeyframes(layer.property("Transform").property("Opacity"), { keyframes: [{time: 0, value: 0}, {time: 1, value: 100}], easing: "easeInOut" });

runnerMeta.note: Operates on a specific Property — call setKeyframes(prop, { keyframes: [...] }) in a script.

actions.name: Set Layer Parent
actions.description: Sets the parent of a child layer within a comp by layer name or index. Pass null as parent to unparent. Prevents self-parenting.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { child: string|number (layer name or 1-based index, required), parent: string|number|null (layer name or 1-based index; null to unparent) }
actions.outputs: boolean — true if the parent was set (or cleared) successfully
actions.whenToUse: You need to parent one layer to another (e.g. camera to null, logo to controller). Use null as parent to break an existing parent link.

actions.name: Set Simple Time Remap Loop
actions.description: Enables time remapping on selected layers, adds the standard seamless loop key, and applies a cycle loop expression to the time remap property.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), expressionType: "cycle"|"pingpong"|"offset"|"continue" (default "cycle"), stretchToComp: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want a footage or precomp layer to loop cleanly for the full composition duration without manually wiring time remap.

actions.name: Set To Average Position
actions.description: Moves one selected layer to the average position of the selected set. By default it targets the last selected layer, matching the community script behavior.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), target: "last"|"first" (default "last") }
actions.outputs: AVLayer — the layer that was repositioned
actions.whenToUse: You need to snap a controller or layer to the centroid of a selected group.

actions.name: Set Track Matte To Above
actions.description: Sets each selected layer's track matte to the layer directly above it, with a configurable matte type.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), matteType: "alpha"|"alphaInverted"|"luma"|"lumaInverted" (default "lumaInverted") }
actions.whenToUse: You want to batch-wire selected layers to use the layer above as their matte instead of setting each matte manually.

actions.name: Set Work Area To Markers
actions.description: Sets the work area to the span between two composition markers.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { startMarkerIndex: number (default 1), endMarkerIndex: number (default 2) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to derive the work area from marker boundaries rather than setting it manually.

actions.name: Shift Layer Start Time
actions.description: Shifts selected layers so the earliest in-point aligns to a target time while preserving relative timing between layers.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), targetTime: number (default comp.time) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to move a selected layer group in time as a unit without disturbing their internal offsets.

actions.name: Swap Property Values
actions.description: Swaps the current values of exactly two compatible selected properties.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.outputs: boolean — true if the values were swapped
actions.whenToUse: You want to exchange two property values without manually copying and pasting.

actions.name: Swap Selected Property Dimensions
actions.description: Swaps the two dimensions of selected 2D properties such as size, position, or scale values.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { properties: Property[] (default comp.selectedProperties) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to quickly flip width/height or x/y values on selected 2D properties.

actions.name: Toggle Maintain Scale Expression
actions.description: Toggles an expression on selected 3D layers so their apparent scale stays visually consistent as Z position changes.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers) }
actions.whenToUse: You want 3D layers to preserve their apparent screen scale while moving in Z space.

actions.name: Toggle Onion Skinning
actions.description: Toggles a CC Wide Time adjustment layer in the comp and stores its source id in the comp comment for later removal.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { marker: string (default "
actions.outputs: boolean — true when onion skinning ends enabled, false when it was disabled
actions.whenToUse: You want a quick onion-skin preview setup without building the adjustment layer manually.

actions.name: Toggle Preserve Nested Frame Rate
actions.description: Sets preserve-nested-frame-rate across all comps in the project.
actions.inputs: opts: { enabled: boolean (default true) }
actions.whenToUse: You want all compositions to consistently preserve nested frame rate or disable that behavior project-wide.

actions.name: Toggle Specific Effects
actions.description: Enables or disables matching effects on layers by effect match name. Defaults to selected layers and can optionally scan every layer in the comp.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), allLayers: boolean (default false), enabled: boolean (default false), effectMatchNames: string[] (default ["ADBE Turbulent Displace"]) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to batch-enable or batch-disable one or more heavy effects during preview or export prep.
actions.example: var count = toggleSpecificEffects(comp, { enabled: true, effectMatchNames: ["ADBE Turbulent Displace", "ADBE Glo2"] });

actions.name: Toggle Timecode And Start Frames
actions.description: Sets the project frame count mode to start on frame 0 or 1 and normalizes comp displayStartFrame to 0.
actions.inputs: opts: { startAtOne: boolean (default true) }
actions.outputs: boolean — true when frame count starts at 1, false when it starts at 0
actions.whenToUse: You want a project-wide frame numbering convention switch without opening preferences.

actions.name: Transfer Composition Work Area
actions.description: Copies the work area from a source comp into app settings, or pastes the saved work area into a target comp.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { mode: "copy"|"paste" (default "copy"), settingsSection: string (default "KM Copy Work Area") }
actions.outputs: boolean — true when the operation completed
actions.whenToUse: You want to carry a work area selection from one composition to another.

actions.name: Unlock All Layers
actions.description: Unlocks all layers in the active comp by default, or every comp in the project when `allComps` is true.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { allComps: boolean (default false) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to clear accidental locking before batch editing.

actions.name: Update Stroke Weight Expressions
actions.description: Replaces an older maintain-stroke-width expression with the newer safer expression across the whole project.
actions.inputs: opts: { oldExpression: string (optional), newExpression: string (optional) }
actions.whenToUse: You want to normalize old stroke-weight maintenance expressions to the safer project-wide variant.

actions.name: Zero Position
actions.description: Creates guide-style zero nulls for selected layers and parents each selected layer to its zero, preserving visual position.
actions.inputs: comp: CompItem; opts: { layers: AVLayer[] (default comp.selectedLayers), prefix: string (default "z_") }
actions.outputs: number — count of zero layers created
actions.whenToUse: You want to zero out layer transforms by inserting a parent at the current position.
